title: ToolShare — Peer-to-peer garage tool rental marketplace (frontend)

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign-in UI plus a minimal user profile create/read/update flow for the signed-in principal.
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity
After sign-in, user can set and later edit a profile display name and optional contact note
Profile data is stored server-side and is retrievable on subsequent sessions for the same principal

file_operations.description: Create the app shell and route layout that includes authentication-aware navigation (sign-in/sign-out) and a profile entry point for the signed-in user.

Implement a Login/Logout button using the Internet Identity hook and clear React Query cache on logout. Use the selected authorization component patterns for login/logout behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an auth gate wrapper that blocks tool/profile/rental data views until authenticated and provides an access-denied/sign-in prompt. Use the selected authorization component guidance for authenticated-only data access; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks to call backend getCallerUserProfile and createOrUpdateProfile/saveCallerUserProfile, including the 'prevent profile setup modal flash' loading semantics described by the selected authorization component; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a modal/dialog that prompts first-time signed-in users to set display name and optional contact note, and allows later edits. Use shadcn-ui Dialog/Form primitives by composition (do not edit immutable UI sources).

Add a small header menu showing the user's display name (not principal) and an option to edit profile. Use the selected authorization component guidance to avoid displaying principal IDs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement authenticated tool listing create/edit/delete UI with frontend-managed photos (store only photo references as strings).
acceptanceCriteria: Owner can create a new listing and see it in their 'My Tools' dashboard
Owner can edit and delete only their own listings
Listing detail view displays all listing fields including photo references
Backend stores photo references, not raw image bytes

file_operations.description: Create the 'My Tools' dashboard page showing the signed-in owner's listings with links to view/edit and a way to remove a listing (with confirmation).

Create a page used for both adding and editing a tool listing, with fields: title, category, description, condition, daily price, optional security deposit, location text, availability flag, and photos (as references).

Implement a photo reference manager UI that only stores and submits an array of string references/URLs/asset paths (no raw image bytes), supports add/remove/reorder, and provides previews when possible.
Create a listing detail view that renders all listing fields, photo reference previews, and owner-only actions (edit/remove) when the viewer is the owner.

Add React Query hooks for tool listing capabilities used by the UI: getTool, getToolsByOwner, addToolListing, editToolListing (and any listing removal capability if present in the backend interface), with optimistic/invalidating updates where appropriate.

Create a small component for owner-only listing actions (edit/remove, availability toggle) that compares the listing owner principal with the authenticated principal. Use the selected authorization component's frontend guidance for principal comparison; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire routes/navigation to 'My Tools', listing create, listing edit, and listing detail pages; ensure these routes are wrapped with RequireAuth so listings management requires login.

requirements.summary: Add marketplace browsing UI for tool listings with search, filters, sorting, and a responsive grid.
acceptanceCriteria: User can browse a listings grid and open a listing detail page
Search and filters update results correctly
Sorting changes the displayed order according to the selected option
The listings grid is usable on mobile and desktop widths

file_operations.description: Create the marketplace browsing page with keyword search over title/description, category filter, price range filter, an 'available only' toggle, and sorting (newest, price low-to-high, price high-to-low), rendering results in a responsive grid.
Implement a responsive listings grid component with listing cards that link to the listing detail page; compose shadcn-ui Card/Button components without editing immutable UI sources.
Create a filter/sort controls component for browse (search input, category select, min/max price inputs, availability toggle, sort select) that updates query state.
Add a React Query hook that calls backend searchTools with the required parameters and maps UI state to the backend sortBy string values used by the app.
Wire a route and nav link for browsing listings, and ensure listing detail navigation is reachable from the browse grid.

requirements.summary: Implement the rental request and booking workflow UI (request date range, approve/decline, status visibility, and status transitions).
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated renter can submit a rental request with a start and end date for a listing
Owner can approve or decline incoming requests for their listing
Approving a request marks it Approved and prevents overlapping approved bookings for that tool/date range
Renter and owner can view the current status and key details of the request/booking

file_operations.description: Add a rental request form (start date, end date) displayed on listing detail pages for non-owners; submit using backend requestRental and show validation/errors.

Create a rental request/booking detail page that shows tool reference, date range, current status, and allowed actions based on whether the user is owner or renter (approve/decline/cancel/complete where applicable).

Implement action buttons to update status via backend updateRentalStatus, with UI guards so only involved parties see actions and status transitions presented are consistent with the supported statuses.
Add React Query hooks for rental data: getRentalsForUser, plus a mutation wrapper for updateRentalStatus and requestRental, including cache invalidation for dashboards and detail views.
Integrate the RentalRequestForm into the listing detail view, gated to authenticated non-owners, and show current availability (via getToolAvailability) to guide renters.
Wire navigation/route for the rental detail view so dashboard items can link to it.

requirements.summary: Create signed-in user dashboards for 'My Tools', 'Requests' (incoming), and 'My Rentals' (outgoing), with correct deep links.
acceptanceCriteria: Signed-in owners can see their listings in 'My Tools'
Signed-in owners can see incoming rental requests in 'Requests'
Signed-in renters can see their submitted requests/bookings in 'My Rentals'
Each dashboard item links to the correct listing and request/booking details

file_operations.description: Create the owner 'Requests' dashboard page listing incoming rental requests for the signed-in user's owned tools, with links to the rental detail view and quick approve/decline entry points.
Create the renter 'My Rentals' dashboard page listing the signed-in user's submitted requests/bookings, with links to the rental detail view and the associated tool listing.
Add a shared dashboard layout (tabs/side nav) to host My Tools, Requests, and My Rentals while composing shadcn-ui components (Tabs, Card, Badge) without editing immutable UI sources.
Wire dashboard routes and navigation entries for 'My Tools', 'Requests', and 'My Rentals', and wrap them in RequireAuth.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent garage/tool marketplace theme (non blue/purple primary) and render generated logo/hero imagery from frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: App uses a consistent theme (not blue/purple as the primary palette) across main views (landing, browse, listing detail, dashboards, create/edit listing)
No edits are made to immutable UI component source paths; components are composed instead
Logo and hero illustration are present in frontend/public/assets/generated and rendered in the UI

file_operations.description: Create global styles and theme tokens (CSS variables/Tailwind usage) to establish a coherent tool/garage aesthetic with a non-blue/purple primary palette (e.g., amber/orange/stone) applied consistently across the app.
Add the generated static logo asset file at the required path so the frontend can reference it directly.
Add the generated static hero illustration asset file at the required path so the frontend can reference it directly.

Create a landing section/page that renders the generated imagery from frontend/public/assets/generated/toolshare-logo.dim_512x512.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/toolshare-hero.dim_1600x900.png, and provides clear CTAs to browse listings and sign in.
Implement a header that includes the brand logo image, primary navigation, and authentication/profile controls by composing shadcn-ui components (no edits to immutable UI sources).
Add a reusable layout wrapper that standardizes spacing/typography/background across views and ensures responsive behavior for mobile and desktop.

Wire the landing view into the app and ensure the header/layout are applied consistently across landing, browse, listing detail, dashboards, and create/edit listing pages; ensure UI composition uses the existing component library rather than editing immutable UI source paths.
